name: Agustín Malandra TCG
summary:
Agustín Malandra TCG is a digital collectible card game built around deck construction, tactical battles and cards inspired by the music and visual universe of Agustín Malandra. Players build custom decks using Character, Field, Equipment and Event cards, combining different abilities, passive effects and strategies to control the battlefield and defeat their opponent.

The game features single-player battles against AI, deck and collection management, online multiplayer, ranked matchmaking, player statistics, seasonal rewards and special events. New cards, expansions and gameplay mechanics are introduced through updates, allowing players to experiment with different deck combinations and strategies.
